description: This file defines the enumeration LoanSubStatus, representing various sub-statuses for a loan within a loan management system. It includes methods to convert integer values to enum instances, check specific statuses, and generate external EnumOptionData representations for each status.

classes.name: LoanSubStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing different sub-statuses of a loan, such as invalid, foreclosed, and contract termination. Provides utility methods for status conversion and comparison.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to a corresponding LoanSubStatus enum instance.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks whether the current status matches the provided state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the status.

methods.name: isContractTermination
methods.description: Checks if the status is 'Contract Termination'.

methods.name: loanSubStatus
methods.description: Creates an EnumOptionData representation for a given status id.

methods.name: loanSubStatusEnum
methods.description: Creates an EnumOptionData representation for a given LoanSubStatus enum instance.
